summary.text: Bill Cunningham is a Democratic member of the Illinois Senate for the 18th District, serving since 2013, according to the Illinois General Assembly, which also lists Cunningham as President Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: Cunningham's legislature biography says Cunningham served in the Illinois House from 2011 to 2013 and holds a B.A. in political science from the University of Illinois at Chicago.
It says Cunningham was previously chief of staff and director of communications for the Cook County Sheriff's Office and lives in Chicago's Beverly community.
